summary: Converts closed line strips into triangles that fill their interiors, with modes for convex-only fast triangulation or slower convex-and-concave triangulation. It can also triangulate quads.

key_params.name: mode
key_params.note: Convex only or convex and concave triangulation

key_params.name: lsmaxverts
key_params.note: Max vertices per closed input line strip in concave mode

key_concepts: Triangulate POP fills closed line strips with triangles and can also convert quad primitives into triangle primitives.
Convex-only mode is the fast path, while convex-and-concave mode handles more shapes but requires explicit vertex and iteration limits.
Long, concave, or self-intersecting line strips need careful max-iteration settings to avoid partial output or excessive cook time.
common_gotchas: Open line strips and unrelated primitive types pass through unmodified.
Convex-only mode is much faster but assumes closed line strips are convex.
Concave mode can get slow on long line strips and needs adequate Max Verts per Input Line Strip.
